validation_period: 1981-01-01 to 1990-12-31 (1980 discarded as spinup per KI dt_023)

raven_diagnostics.note: Raven internal metrics include spinup year 1980; our metrics exclude it

s3_convert_forcing_to_rvt.reason: KI tool expects VIC-preprocessed forcing files; Wangjiaba has no VIC run. Wrote custom CMFD extraction following KI unit rules.

issues: CRITICAL: select_model_template.py generates ':Precipitation PRECIP_RAVEN' without ATMOS_PRECIP MULTIPLE arguments. Raven v4.1 warns 'improper line length' and the first run produced no Hydrographs.csv. Fixed manually.
MODERATE: HMETS parameter names in build_rvp_parameters.py don't match Raven v4.1 (DD_MELT_TEMP, DD_MELT_FACTOR, DD_REFREEZE_FACTOR are unrecognized). Raven auto-generates defaults.
MODERATE: convert_forcing_to_rvt.py assumes VIC-preprocessed forcing exists. For standalone Raven runs on new basins without VIC, there's no clean CMFD-to-Raven path.
MINOR: convert_forcing_to_rvt.py CMFD NetCDF fallback path uses 'from pathlib import Path' but Path is not imported at module level (would fail at runtime).
MINOR: CustomOutput with BY_BASIN generates .nc files but Raven was compiled without NetCDF — produces 0-byte files.
MINOR: CMFD daily precip is in kg/m²/s (not mm/day). The KI's unit table in SKILL.md says 'mm/3hr' for CMFD — this is for 3-hourly files, not daily.
MINOR: Daily CMFD only provides mean temp, not min/max. HMETS needs TEMP_MIN/TEMP_MAX. Estimated as mean ±5°C — a rough approximation.
MINOR: generate_rvc_initial.py includes SNOW_DEPTH and COLD_CONTENT state variables that HMETS doesn't use (Raven warns).
ki_gaps: GAP-1 (CRITICAL): Precipitation process in .rvi templates missing compartment arguments (ATMOS_PRECIP MULTIPLE). Affects ALL templates, not just HMETS. Without this fix, model produces no hydrograph output.
GAP-2 (HIGH): HMETS parameter names don't match Raven v4.1. The KI uses DD_MELT_FACTOR but Raven expects MELT_FACTOR. Same for DD_REFREEZE_FACTOR -> REFREEZE_FACTOR, DD_MELT_TEMP -> unrecognized.

GAP-3 (HIGH): No standalone forcing path. convert_forcing_to_rvt.py requires VIC-preprocessed forcing files. For new basins without VIC pipeline, agents must write custom CMFD extraction. Need a --forcing_source cmfd_direct mode.
GAP-4 (MEDIUM): GAMMA_SHAPE and GAMMA_SCALE parameters set as LandUseParameters but Raven reports them as 'not used within this model formulation' for HMETS. May need different parameter placement.
GAP-5 (LOW): run_raven.py success detection has operator precedence bug: `(rc == 0 and 'Hydrographs.csv' in outputs) or any(...)` should use parentheses around the `or` clause.
GAP-6 (LOW): Unit table in SKILL.md only documents VIC forcing column conversions (mm/3hr, K, W/m2, Pa). Missing documentation for direct CMFD NetCDF units (kg/m²/s for precip, K for temp).
GAP-7 (LOW): SilentMode warning: KI template includes :SilentMode which doesn't affect Hydrographs.csv, but removing it improved debugging visibility.
assessment: The Raven KI GENERALIZES to new basins with manual intervention for 2 critical issues: (1) Precipitation compartment fix in .rvi, (2) custom forcing extraction. Once these are fixed, the pipeline works end-to-end. The model produces physically reasonable discharge (r=0.86, correct monsoon seasonality) despite uncalibrated parameters. Parameter name mismatches degrade performance but don't prevent execution. Overall: KI is ~80% ready for autonomous new-basin deployment.
